plugins.description: Draft, schedule and publish to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Threads and Bluesky through the hosted Socialync MCP server, with your approval on every post. Includes recipes for a week of Shorts, a blog post into a week of posts, a weekly review and image carousels.
